meta.name: Phony
meta.description: After waking up from a freak car accident, Sonny discovers that his mother has been replaced by an impostor.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Sonny awakens from a car accident to find his mom, Ellen, looks slightly different.

videos.title: Crosby, Stills and Nash
videos.overview: Sonny tries to find help. Weldon leads them to a private investigator.

videos.title: Reverse Cuckoo Situation
videos.overview: Sonny is trapped with Ellen while rumors of a dead body spread through school.

videos.title: Vibes Are Rancid
videos.overview: Sonny goes to a party to find Shovel, who might have details about his “real” mom’s fate.

videos.title: House of Dog
videos.overview: Sonny skips school with Mallory. Ellen investigates Sonny’s suspicious behavior.

videos.title: I'm Right Here
videos.overview: Sonny’s discovery about his mom's past leads to a potentially dangerous search for answers.

videos.title: What Comes Up?
videos.overview: Sonny seeks out therapy and tries to return to normal while Mallory embraces her faith.
